reason: Conversation 2 got the homeowner to the right practical outcome: a power cycle cleared the code and the oven heated normally, with no parts and no engineer. It did state an unsupported claim (E011 as a temperature sensor fault) and then wrongly attributed the fix to a 'glitch' rather than linking it to the wet-cleaned touch panel, missing the chance to advise keeping the panel dry. Conversation 1 was worse: it ignored the explicit clue that the fault began right after wet-wiping the control panel, asked irrelevant clock and child-lock questions, never suggested drying or a reset, and escalated to a paid engineer for what was a trivially self-resolvable issue.
